title: packet-http3: add support for webtransport settings and frame types
description:
This change adds support for new HTTP/3 settings and frame types defined for WebTransport and Datagrams protocol.
https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9297/
https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-webtrans-http3/

notes.body:
Hi Gustavo, 

May be split on two patch for H3_datagram (it is on my long todo) and a another for Web Transport Settings ?

can you also share a pcap ?
